proposals.evidence: DEDR 2965 directly gives Konda ḍumu ‘bone’, with Telugu dummu and Kuvi ḍumu ‘large bone’. The survey ḍumu agrees with the complete Konda noun; the size qualification belongs to Kuvi and is not imposed on Konda.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 2165(a) explicitly records Konda goṟe ‘goat’, following Gondi gore ‘goat’, alongside sheep senses in southern languages. The survey gore ‘goat’ preserves this Konda-specific meaning; the antelope compounds in subsection (b) are excluded.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 2991 explicitly gives Konda ḍōma ‘mosquito’, alongside Telugu dōma and Kannada dōme. The survey ḍoma matches the Konda noun; the blind-bee sense belongs to one Kolami attestation and is not imposed here.
